villager_1.who: A young village woman in a simple ankle-length dress of faded blue with a cream apron, sleeves rolled to the elbow, brown hair tied back in a short tail, brown shoes. Cheerful and ordinary — she is one of the townsfolk, not an adventurer.

idle: standing still, weight on both feet, arms relaxed at her sides
the same stance a moment later, having shifted her weight slightly and let one hand rest on her hip
walk: mid-stride with her LEFT leg forward and her right arm forward
passing pose, both legs nearly together, body at its highest
mid-stride with her RIGHT leg forward and her left arm forward
passing pose again, both legs nearly together, body at its highest

idle: standing still, weight on both feet, arms relaxed at his sides

passing pose again, both legs nearly together, body at its highest

farmer.who: A sturdy farmhand in a cream linen shirt with the sleeves rolled up, a brown leather apron, olive trousers and muddy boots, a straw hat pushed back off his forehead. He carries a long-handled hoe.

the same stance a moment later, having shifted his weight slightly

mid-stride with his RIGHT leg forward and his left arm forward
passing pose again, both legs nearly together, body at its highest
action: standing over the ground with the hoe raised high behind him, both hands on the shaft, about to strike
mid-swing, the hoe coming down in front of him, his body bending forward into it
the blade in the soil at his feet, his back bent and his knees slightly flexed at the end of the stroke

woodcutter.who: A broad-shouldered woodcutter in a red-brown checked shirt with the sleeves cut off, a thick leather belt, dark green trousers and heavy boots, a short dark beard. He carries a felling axe.

the same stance a moment later, having shifted his weight slightly

quarryman.who: A wiry quarryman in a grey sleeveless tunic white with stone dust, a leather harness over one shoulder, patched brown trousers and scuffed boots, a cloth tied over his hair. He carries a pickaxe.

stonemason.who: A calm stonemason in a pale grey tunic and a long canvas apron dusted white, leather bracers on both forearms, brown trousers and flat shoes, hair tied back. She works with a mallet and a chisel.

smith.who: A powerful smith in a soot-dark sleeveless tunic and a heavy brown leather apron, thick gloves, dark trousers and iron-shod boots, sweat-damp hair pushed back. He works with a hammer and tongs.
